column1: # CANDIDO JUANICO HAD TWO WIVES, and this archive had inferred it before it could prove it.
# Resolved 13 September 2026 by searching him as FATHER across the Uruguayan collections.
# The register note on Dona Juliana Gonzalez had read: "Published genealogy gives Candido's wife
# as SIXTA Lenguas Gonzalez, married 1857 - too late for a daughter marrying in 1864, so Juliana
# is an earlier wife. That is an inference." *** The inference was right. ***

column3: b. 23 Nov 1842, bapt. 4 Oct 1843, San Francisco de Asis
column4: *** THE FIRST WIFE, and ours. *** Julia married Luis Eugenio Lerena Lenguas in 1864 and is the mother of the Rosario child of 1866.

column2: Sara Juanico Lenguas (m. Pedro Casaravilla 1894); Zara Sista Emirena Juanico (b. 14 Oct 1869, bapt. 16 Feb 1870); Celia Juanico Lenguas
column4: *** THE SECOND WIFE. *** Her children are born a full generation after Julia, which is exactly what the archive predicted from the 1857 marriage date. The published genealogy was not wrong about the marriage - it was wrong to attach it to Julia.

column1: # *** NOTE THE SURNAME OF THE SECOND WIFE. *** Candido Juanico's second wife was a LENGUAS, and
# his daughter by his first wife married a Lerena LENGUAS. Justiniana Lenguas and Sixta Lenguas
# are very likely kin. These were not two families that met by chance in a large city; they were
# already connected. Recorded as an observation, not a proved relationship - no record read here
# yet links Justiniana and Sixta directly.
# One more echo: Candido's daughter by Sixta is "Zara SISTA EMIRENA Juanico", and Julia's own
# eldest - the Rosario child of 1866 - is "Maria Julia Margarita Josefa EMIRENA Justiniana".
# EMIRENA is not a common name. The half-sisters were given it a year apart.
